opis: The bright children's room from the reference picture (the same wallpaper, the window, the bed, the rug and the bookcase) in warm afternoon light, autumn leaves seen through the window. The room is TIDY: three picture books stand together in a row on the white window sill, the toys (a teddy bear, a red-and-white ball, wooden blocks) sit together at the left edge of the rug, the clothes (striped socks, red shoes) lie in a cardboard box by the wall on the right. In the middle of the rug a checked picnic cloth with ONE big golden APPLE PIE, one slice cut out, little plates and cups. The FOX, wearing a red knitted winter hat, holds a slice of pie and laughs; the SQUIRREL pours tea; the ROE DEER lies on the rug beside them, smiling. Cosy, happy and calm - new friends together.
